description: updated privacy focused release for iFunny 10.45.14

patches.name: Block ads
patches.description: Stops all bundled ad SDKs from initialising or loading ads (AppLovin MAX, AdMob, Meta, Prebid, BidMachine, Smaato, InMobi, Fyber, Unity, Pangle, BIGO, Vungle, Moloco, Amazon, Nimbus) and removes the empty banner space. Premium is not unlocked.

patches.name: Block cleartext traffic
patches.description: Disallows unencrypted HTTP connections app-wide (the stock app allows them everywhere).

patches.name: Block identity trackers
patches.description: Disables LiveRamp ATS (hashed-email identity graph) and the HUMAN/WhiteOps device-fingerprinting SDK.

patches.name: Bypass VPN detection
patches.description: Always reports that no VPN is active to the ad SDK that checks for one.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Disables AppsFlyer, Yandex AppMetrica, Firebase Analytics, iFunny's own event uploads and the upload of ad/attribution IDs to iFunny's servers.

patches.name: Disable crash reporters
patches.description: Disables Firebase Crashlytics and Firebase Sessions telemetry.

patches.name: Disable location
patches.description: Removes the location permissions and stops iFunny's background location upload. The in-app map will no longer work.

patches.name: Hide Premium upsells
patches.description: Hides the "Hide ads" tab and badge, the Boost post button and the Premium / Trial / limited-time-offer entries in the toolbar and side menu. Does not unlock Premium.

patches.name: Hide promo cards
patches.description: Removes Premium trial promo cards, surveys, "ask to smile" prompts and the inline push-notification request from the feed. Content cards are kept.

patches.name: Limit ad tracking
patches.description: Removes advertising-ID, Privacy Sandbox, Google Services ID, account-list and vendor app-info permissions, denies analytics/ad consent by default and removes root-app detection queries.

patches.name: Material You theme
patches.description: Recolors iFunny with your wallpaper-based Material You (dynamic) colors on Android 12+, and fixes low-contrast date / view-count text.

options.description: Use a pure black background. Cards and toolbars keep a subtle Material You tint.

patches.name: Strip photo location
patches.description: Removes GPS and camera serial/owner EXIF tags from JPEG, PNG and WebP images before upload. A cache copy is uploaded; the original photo is never modified.

release_notes:
Initial release for iFunny 10.45.14.

Privacy: disables AppsFlyer, AppMetrica, Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, LiveRamp and HUMAN; removes location and ad-ID permissions; strips GPS from photo uploads; blocks cleartext HTTP.
Ads: blocks ~18 ad SDKs, removes promo cards, Hide-ads tabs, Boost and Premium upsells. Premium is not unlocked.
Theme: Material You dynamic colors with an AMOLED black option.
